narrative.intro: Sprezzatura Management Consulting obligated $240M in FY2026 to date. Sprezzatura Management Consulting has 7 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $34.3M. Obligations rose up 994.4% year over year. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the largest buyer, with $241M in obligations. Custom Computer Programming Services is the dominant market, with $234M in obligations, followed by Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services at $5.6M and Computer Systems Design Services at $300K. Historical obligations were smaller in prior years: FY21 $15.8M, FY22 $15.6M, FY23 $19.4M, FY24 $13.5M, and FY25 $21.9M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. The FY2026 picture shows a concentrated set of large programming-services obligations compared with those prior-year totals, and the company’s average award size reflects several high-value awards in the current fiscal period.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes drive Sprezzatura Management Consulting obligations?
sections.body: Custom Computer Programming Services accounts for $234M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services accounts for $5.6M, Computer Systems Design Services accounts for $300K, and the company’s average award size is $34.3M across 7 awards.
